prompts.title: System prompt versions
prompts.activeLine: Active version: v{version} — this is the assistant's ENTIRE system prompt.
prompts.coreLine: NO ACTIVE VERSION — the assistant refuses every chat (503) until one is activated.
prompts.placeholder: The whole system prompt. Placeholders: {WEEKDAY}, {TODAY}, {LEADING_LANGUAGE}, {USER_CONTEXT} — substituted on every turn.
prompts.coreOnlyConfirm: WARNING: without an active version the assistant REFUSES every chat (error 503). Continue?
prompts.legend: Placeholders: {WEEKDAY} — the weekday, {TODAY} — the date (Europe/Vilnius), {LEADING_LANGUAGE} — the language name, {USER_CONTEXT} — the signed-in student's group or the guest instructions.
